name: IMU-D
description: IMU-D is a reproducible fault-injection benchmark for severity-aware GNSS/IMU fusion localization. It defines F1-F9 IMU fault types, a worst-case ΔATE severity metric, a two-stage analytical model, ESKF/EKF evaluation, synthetic trajectories, and UrbanNav real-data experiments. The package includes source code, configuration, result manifests, and reproducibility documentation.
